about: The keep-out zones of workspace/templates/workshop_template.pptx, read by check_deck (harness/tools/deck_edit.py). Positions are in cm from the slide's top-left corner (the slide is 33.87 x 19.05 cm). The bottom-right corner is kept for the workshop logo, and content stays above the footer rule at 17.25 cm; the template's own date, footer and slide-number placeholders live below the rule. workspace/deck_demo/briefing.pptx draws the logo and the rule on its slide master. Copy this file for your own template and change the numbers.

keep_out.why: everything on a slide stays above the footer rule
